name: Fuji Corporation
summary: Fuji Corporation manufactures and sells electronic component mounting robots and machine tools in Japan. The company operates through Robot Solutions, Machine Tools, and Other segments. It offers electric component mounting robot, machine tools, atmospheric pressure plasma unit, transfer support robot, smart locker system, and waste sorting robot. The company was formerly known as Fuji Machine Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fuji Corporation in April 2018. Fuji Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Chiryu, Japan.
